CustomField.description: This cycle's Amount minus the Prior Cycle Grant's Amount. Positive means the funder increased the award. Blank - not zero - when there is no prior cycle or either Amount is empty, so grand totals are not skewed by first-time asks.
CustomField.formula: IF( OR( ISBLANK(Prior_Cycle_Grant__c), ISBLANK(Amount), ISBLANK(Prior_Cycle_Grant__r.Amount) ), NULL, Amount - Prior_Cycle_Grant__r.Amount )
CustomField.label: YoY Award Change
